precond.SawEvent: The current farmer has seen any of the given events.
precond.MissingPet: The current farmer hasn't received a pet yet, and (if specified) has this pet preference.
precond.IsHost: The current farmer is the host.
precond.HostMail: The host farmer has this mail.
precond.WorldState: This world state ID is active anywhere.
precond.HostOrLocalMail: Either the host or current farmer have this mail.
precond.EarnedMoney: The current farmer has earned at least this much money, including spent money.
precond.HasMoney: The current farmer has at least this much money, not including spent money.
precond.FreeInventorySlots: The current farmer has at least this many free slots in their inventory.
precond.CommunityCenterOrWarehouseDone: The community center or Joja warehouse have been completed.
precond.Dating: The current farmer is dating the given NPC.
precond.DaysPlayed: The main farmer has played at least this many days.
precond.JojaBundlesDone: All Joja bundles has been completed.
precond.Friendship: The current farmer has at least this many friendship points with all of the given NPCs.
precond.Random: A random check with the given probability matches.
precond.Shipped: The current farmer has shipped at least this many of each given item ID.
precond.SawSecretNote: The current farmer has seen this secret note.
precond.ChoseDialogueAnswers: The current farmer has selected all of the given dialogue answer IDs.
precond.LocalMail: The current farmer has received this mail.
precond.GoldenWalnuts: All players have found at least this many golden walnuts combined, including spent walnuts.
precond.InUpgradedHouse: The current location is a farmhouse or cabin, and it has been upgraded to the max level (level 2 or greater).
precond.Time: The current time of day is between the given values inclusively.
precond.Weather: The weather in the current location's context is rainy, sunny, or the given weather ID.
precond.DayOfWeek: The current day of week is one of these values (in the form Mon, Tue, etc).
precond.Spouse: The current farmer is married to or engaged with this NPC.
precond.Roommate: The current farmer is roommates with any NPC.
precond.NpcVisible: The given NPC is present and visible in any location.
precond.NpcVisibleHere: The given NPC is present and visible in the current location.
precond.Season: The current calendar season is one of the given values.
precond.SpouseBed: The current farmer has a spouse bed in their house.
precond.ReachedMineBottom: The current farmer has reached the bottom of the mines (i.e. level 120) at least this many times.
precond.Year: The current year is exactly 1 (if specified 1) or at least the given value (if specified any other value).
precond.Gender: The current farmer has this gender.
precond.HasItem: The current farmer has this item ID in their inventory.
precond.Tile: The current farmer is standing on one of these tile positions.
precond.ActiveDialogueEvent: The current player has this active dialogue event.
precond.SendMail: Send the specified mail and end the event. This is a way to send mail without actually starting the event, it's not a regular event precondition.
precond.DayOfMonth: Today is one of the given days of month.
precond.UpcomingFestival: A festival day will occur within the given number of days.
precond.Skill: The current farmer has a minimum skill level.
